Officer's narrative
Drvier 1 was traveling through the intersection on a green signal when Driver 2 entered from the cross street and
struck the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle did not stop fully before entering the
intersection. A passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported being dazed after the impact and
complained of a concussion, though it remains unclear whether the reported injury resulted from this collision. It is
also not fully established which seat within the vehicle Driver 1 occupied at the time of impact. Witness statements,
scene photographs, and the account given by Driver 2 all agree with the sequence of events described by Driver 1.
The damage visible on both vehicles is largely consistent with the reported angle and force of the impact. Officers
found no indication of prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy
covering the vehicle. Medical evaluation was recommended at the scene and Driver 1 was transported for further
assessment.
</page>

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.

- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
